name: Bondage
overview: The Bible reveals bondage as a state of harsh oppression and servitude, exemplified by the Israelites' bitter labor in Egypt under rigorous conditions (Exodus 1:14). Their cries of distress reached God, who promised deliverance and redemption from their burdens (Exodus 2:23; 6:6). Bondage also appears in the context of the Israelites' captivity in Persia, where despite being bondmen, God's mercy provided revival and restoration to His people (Ezra 9:9). These passages emphasize God's sovereignty in delivering His people from physical and spiritual captivity, contrasting the faithfulness of God with the futility of idolatry and moral compromise (Leviticus 26:1; Proverbs 25:26).
